title: SII Vol. 13 No. 1 — Tiruvarur
location_detail: On the south wall of the Achalesvara shrine, Tyagarajasvamin temple
summary: This records a gift of two silver vessels in which offerings were to be made to god Tiruvaraneri-Alvar by Udaiyapirattiyar Sembian-Mahadeviyar for the merit of Uttama-Choladeva

title: SII Vol. 13 No. 2 — Srinivasanallur
location_detail: On the east wall of the Korangunathan temple
summary: This records a gift of 30 sheep and 30 goats to provide ghee for a perpetual lamp in the temple of Tirukurakkuturai-Perumanadigal at Mahendramangalam, by Kappiyan Euvan Gangadharan of the village for the merit of Gangadharan Arattan

title: SII Vol. 13 No. 3
location_detail: On the north wall of the same temple
summary: This inscription gives a list of the several tax-free temple lands with their incomes specifically allocated for the various requirements (of the temple) at the instance of Araiyar Acharakanta-Brahmadhiraja to the Mulaparishad of Mahendramangalam, who had this re-engraved on stone after collecting t

title: SII Vol. 13 No. 4 — Tiruvellarai
location_detail: On the west wall of the central shrine in the Jambunatha temple
summary: This inscription records an agreement given by the Mulaparishad of Tiruvellarai to burn a perpetual lamp in the temple of Tiruvanaikkallil-Bhattarakar with the interest on 25 kalanju of gold endowed by Marudan Achchan of Sankarappadi, (a hamlet of) Tiruvellarai

title: SII Vol. 13 No. 5
location_detail: On a pillar in the rock-cut cave, Pundarikaksha Perumal temple in the same village
summary: This inscription is fragmentary and damaged

title: SII Vol. 13 No. 6 — Uraiyur
location_detail: On the south wall of the central shrine, Panchavarnesvara temple
summary: This inscription is built in at the end of each line

title: SII Vol. 13 No. 7 — Tiruvidaimarudur
location_detail: On the south wall of thecentral shrine, Mahalingasvamin temple
summary: This records an endowment of 8 ilukkasu by a certain kuralai Duggaiya-Kramavittan of Emanallur, a brahmadeya village in Manni-nadu on the northern bank (of the Kaveri), who was an agent of a chief (?) of Kila-nadu, for the daily supply of ten plantain fruits for offering to the image of Purana-Ganap

title: SII Vol. 13 No. 8 — Tiruvisalur
location_detail: On the north wall of the central shrine, Sivayoganathasvamin temple
summary: This records a gift of 90 sheep and a ram for a perpetual lamp in the temple of Tiruvisalur-Perumanadigal at Amaninarana-chaturvedimagalam, a devadana-brahmadeya in Manni-nadu by Pannagada-Muvendavelar of Pennagadam in Tanjavur-kurram

title: SII Vol. 13 No. 10 — Tirunaraiyur
location_detail: On the south wall of the central shrine, Siddhanathasvamin temple
summary: This records the gift of a silver plate and a pot and also a chauri with gold handle, by Udaiyapirattiyar Sembiyan-Mahadeviyar alias Pirantakan-Madevadigalar to the temple of Siddhesvaram-udaiya-Mahadeva at Tirunaraiyur in Tirunaraiyur-nadu

title: SII Vol. 13 No. 12
location_detail: On the same wall
summary: It seems to record an endowment of an areca garden to the temple of Sambaresvara at Nalur in Serrur-kurram

title: SII Vol. 13 No. 13 — Tirunagesvaram
location_detail: On a pillar lying in a mandapa at the end of the street in front of the Naganathasvamin temple
summary: This inscription is engraved in archaic characters and has been assigned therefore to Aditya I

title: SII Vol. 13 No. 14 — Tirumananjeri
location_detail: On the south wall of thecentral shrine, Udvahanathasvamin temple
summary: This records an order of Sembiyan-Mahadeviyar, the mother of Uttama-Chola fixing the allotment of paddy for the several items of daily expense in the temple of Tirukkarrali-Mahadeva at Tirumananjeri, near Kadalangudi in Kurukkai-nadu, out of the produce from 14 veli of land endowed by her in Mulangu

title: SII Vol. 13 No. 16
location_detail: On the east inner gopura, left side, of the same temple
summary: This records an endowment of 60 kalanju of gold by a certain Ayyan Vembadigal of the Parttivasekarat-terinja-Kaikkolar (regiment ?) for daily offerings and for feeding in the temple of Tiruvengadudevar

title: SII Vol. 13 No. 17 — Udayargudi
location_detail: On the north wall of the central shrine, Anantesvara temple
summary: A gift of 12 Â½ kalanju of gold for a perpetual lamp in the temple of Tiruvanantisvarattu-Paramasvami at Viranarayana-chaturvedimangalam by Kanjai Tiruvenkada-Kramavittan of Kondandaramachcheri

title: SII Vol. 13 No. 18 — Tiruvaduturai
location_detail: On the south wall of the central shrine, Gomuktisvara temple
summary: This is an incomplete inscription, recording a gift of 12 kalanju of gold for a perpetual lamp in the temple of Tiruvavaduturai-Mahadeva at Sattanur, a brahmadeya in Tiraimur-nadu by a merchant of Karuppur

title: SII Vol. 13 No. 17
location_detail: above

title: SII Vol. 13 No. 19 — Tiruvidaikkali
location_detail: On the north wall of the mandapa in frong of the central shrine, Subrahmanya temple
summary: It seems to register the mortgage of a piece of land for the dues of 200 kalam of paddy by Korrappalli Kandan Ayyan, a resident scholar (?) of the village, to the temple at Tiruvidaikkali, a devadana in Kurumbur-nadu

title: SII Vol. 13 No. 20 — Tiruppugalur
location_detail: On the south wall of thecntral shrine, Agnipurisvara temple
summary: This is a fragmentary epigraph registering a gift of a silver vessel to (god) Sri Pugalurdeva

title: SII Vol. 13 No. 21 — Tiruppalanam
location_detail: On the north wall of the central shrine, Apatsahayesvara temple
summary: This records a gift of 30 kalanju of gold for a perpetual lamp in the temple of Mahadeva at Tiruppalanam, a devadana in Mirai-kurram, by Solaperumanadigal Perunerkillich-Chola

title: SII Vol. 13 No. 15

title: SII Vol. 13 No. 22 — Tiruchchatturai
location_detail: On the south wall of the central shrine, Odanavanesvara temple
summary: This records an endowment of 145 kalanju of gold by Somasi Sendan alias Solaperunkavidi, the Madhyastha of Ayirattali, for daily offerings in the temple of Tiruchchorrutturai-Mahadeva

title: SII Vol. 13 No. 23 — Kudumiyamalai
location_detail: On the south wall of the rock-cut shrine, Melaikoyil temple
summary: This records a gift of 31 cows for the supply of milk for the early morning bath of the deity, and milk and ghee for offerings in the temple of Tirunilakkunrattu-Paramesvara by Sandaiyan, a cavalier of Mahimalaiya-Irukkuvelar

title: SII Vol. 13 No. 24 — Vedaranyam
location_detail: On a pillar in the mandapa in front of the Tyagaraja shrine in the Vedaranyesvara temple
summary: It seems to record a gift of 90 sheep for a perpetual lamp in the temple of Mahadeva at Tirumaraikkadu, a devadana in Umbala-nadu, by a lady, Nangai [Pa]ravvaiyar, a -parikai- in the Big Temple (or palace at Tiruvarur and another individual, probably an officer of the king (Tiru-ulagaperumanar)

title: SII Vol. 13 No. 25
location_detail: On another pillar in the same mandapa
summary: This records a similar gift of 90 sheep left in charge of the servants of the temple at Tirumaraikkadu, a devadana in Umbala-nadu, for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple with an ulakku of ghee daily, by a native of Velur in Oyma-nadu
